description: This Java interface defines a behavior for retrieving configuration data within an Akka actor-based system, specifically handling RetrieveConfig messages by fetching configuration details, converting them to JSON, and responding accordingly.

classes.name: RetrieveConfigBehavior
classes.description: A Java interface extending Akka's Actor to define behavioral logic for retrieving configuration data, including a default method that creates a receive block to handle RetrieveConfig messages.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Abstract method that should be implemented to return the relevant Config object, which may be different from the system default.

methods.name: retrieveConfigBehavior
methods.description: Default method that returns an Akka Receive block, handling RetrieveConfig messages by fetching configuration, converting to JSON, and responding, or handling exceptions appropriately.
